# v0.7.4 — 统一工具层与面板的 hdc 探测 / Unified hdc discovery (fixes #4)

## 问题 / Problem

DevEco Studio 安装在非默认路径时（#4 的 Windows 实例：`D:\DevEco Studio`），命令行工具一切正常，但浮动面板报 `hdc not found`。根因：插件存在两条独立的 hdc 发现路径——工具层（hdc-core）有 PATH 回退，而面板层只有一份硬编码候选清单且无回退，非默认安装时两侧表现不一致。

When DevEco Studio is installed outside the default location, every tool worked while the floating panel kept reporting `hdc not found`. The panel had its own hardcoded candidate list with no PATH fallback, unlike the tool layer.

## 修复 / Fix

- **新建 `lib/hdc-discover.mjs` 单一事实源**：默认安装根 × API 版本（default…18）交叉积、`Ver:` 校验正则与 not-found 文案收敛为一处，工具层与面板共用
- **面板三层解析**：优先复用工具层本次会话已解析的 hdc 路径 → 共享候选清单 → PATH 回退（win32 `where.exe` / POSIX `which`）；保持直连 execFile 架构不变
- **非默认安装的识别来源**：`DEVECO_SDK_HOME` 环境变量 > 本机检测到的 DevEco Studio SDK > 默认安装根 > PATH；`findStudioRoot` 补上 DEVECO_SDK_HOME 邻接探测
- **顺带修复**：`hms_setup action=paths` 必抛的 ReferenceError（candidateList 未导出）；彻底移除发布产物中的维护者机器路径（三处硬编码安装盘符）
- **回归防护**：smoke 新增六项断言（工具层候选全败时 PATH 命中、面板复用解析结果、面板自身 PATH 回退、paths 分支不抛错、无机器路径残留等）

The panel now reuses the path already resolved by the tools when available, then walks the same shared candidate list, and finally probes PATH — with `DEVECO_SDK_HOME` and the locally detected Studio SDK honored as priority roots. Also fixes a hidden crash in `hms_setup action=paths` and scrubs machine-specific hardcoded paths from the package.

## 兼容性 / Compatibility

零依赖承诺不变；浏览器端兼容面（`state.hdc/error/devices/toolchain` 字段）不动；升级后 issue #4 中的本地 pnpm patch 不再需要。

Zero runtime dependencies unchanged; client-facing state fields untouched; the local pnpm patch workaround from #4 is no longer needed after upgrade.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
